meta.title: Anime Squadron traits data
meta.acquisitionNote: Traits are rerolled with Trait Shards from Story mode at the Trait Roll NPC near the Upgrades waypoint. BloxInformer says 1 Trait Shard gives 1 reroll.
meta.notes: BloxInformer is the only complete row-level trait source found during research. Preserve source chance strings because the three 11.3% rows appear rounded.

items.name: Endure
items.acquisitionNote: Reroll traits with Trait Shards at the Trait Roll NPC near the Upgrades waypoint.
items.cardSummary: A common defensive roll that gives a simple HP boost for units that need more staying power.
items.sourceImageAlt: Endure Trait from Anime Squadron Roblox Experience
items.imageStatus: local image saved from BloxInformer trait icon
items.sourceNotes: BloxInformer lists Endure at 20% with +10% HP.
